photo.alt: View over the city from the north tower of St. Stephen's Cathedral

facts: About 2 million people (2025), the most populous city on the Danube
On the eastern edge of the Vienna Woods, the Alps' northeasternmost foothills
worth_knowing: The Romans founded a camp here in the 1st century and called it Vindobona. From the 16th century the Habsburgs made it the seat of the Holy Roman emperors.
